details:
Cockpit component for managing libvirt virtual machines.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * cockpit-machines: cockpit-machines: Sensitive data exposure via command-line arguments (CVE-2026-92768)
  * cockpit-machines: cockpit-machines: Sensitive Data Exposure of guest credentials via JSON argument in process list (CVE-2026-92747)
  * cockpit-machines: cockpit-machines: Information Disclosure of RHSM Offline Token via Process Arguments (CVE-2026-92745)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
